data.name: HeadBallz
data.detailed_description:
Step into a chaotic party arena where physics, quick reactions, and pure fun take center stage.

Compete in online matches with up to four players, fight for control of the ball, and score goals in compact arena maps built for nonstop action. Matches are easy to jump into and perfect for quick, competitive sessions with friends.

Choose from a cast of cartoon animal characters, each with their own distinct look and personality from powerful bulls to tough turtles and more. The focus is on gameplay, movement, and chaotic moments rather than complex systems.

Simple social tools let you manage your experience, including the ability to block players and focus on enjoying fair and fun matches.

Whether you’re playing to win or just to mess around, every match is filled with unpredictable physics, clutch goals, and laugh-out-loud moments.

Key Features

  • Online multiplayer for up to 4 players

  • Fast-paced arena-based gameplay

  • Custom Physics-driven ball mechanics

  • Playable cartoon animal characters

  • Player blocking and basic social features

  • Quick matches designed for fun and replayability

Easy to pick up, hard to put down grab your friends and jump into the arena.

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
